paragraphs.text:
1
You meet a kid who wants to follow you. If you refuse, he will
go away. If you let him join your exploration, roll d6. On a 1-3,
go to event #26, on a 4-6 go to event #37.

2
You find something (roll on the Random Objects or the Useful
Stuff table, your choice) spattered in blood. You may decide
to ignore the object or pick it up (go to event #31).

3
You spot a random object on a dangerous place. Roll on the
Random Object or on the Useful Stuff table (your choice) to
determine what it is. Climbing the obstacle will require a L4
climbing roll, at +1 if you have the Agile Skill, +2 if you have it
at Expert level. On a failure, you fall and lose 1 Life. On a
success, you gain the object. You may try to climb the obstacle
as many times as you want.

4
A ghastly face appears at a window. Save vs. L3 Fear (+1 if you
have Will, +2 if you have Will at Expert level) or lose 1 Sanity.
If you want to enter the building and investigate, go to event
#34. You may ignore this apparition, carrying on with your
investigation.
5 A chilly wind blows. If you have a torch or candle, the wind will
blow it out until the end of your next encounter.

6
You stumble upon a pool of yellow goo in the middle of the
road. If you have a jar or bottle, you may pick up some, in case
it may be useful later.
